lines.text: Harry the hamster discovered a secret meadow bursting with thousands of sunflower seeds!
He stuffed his cheeks until they were round balloons and carted all five hundred seeds home!
He piled them in his underground vault and locked the door with a sturdy wooden twig!
Sitting on a giant mountain of seeds in the dark, his tummy felt full but his heart felt empty!
Outside, winter winds were blowing cold and his forest friends had very little to eat!
Harry loaded a wooden wheelbarrow and delivered baskets of roasted seeds to every den!
The forest erupted in cheerful songs, and they invited Harry to a warm winter feast!
Hoarding things brings worry, but sharing your abundance fills your life with true warmth!
